description: This file provides utility functions and data structures for handling wizard steps and options, including encoding/decoding, type conversions, and comparison functions used in wizard workflows.

classes.name: WizardOption
classes.description: A structure representing a wizard option, including its value, label, and optional hint.

methods.name: decodeWizardStep
methods.description: Decodes a raw dictionary into a WizardStep object, returning nil if decoding fails.

methods.name: parseWizardOptions
methods.description: Parses an array of dictionaries into an array of WizardOption instances.

methods.name: wizardStatusString
methods.description: Extracts and trims a string status from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: wizardStepType
methods.description: Retrieves the 'type' string from a WizardStep object.

methods.name: anyCodableString
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to its string representation.

methods.name: anyCodableBool
methods.description: Converts an AnyCodable value to a boolean.

methods.name: anyCodableArray
methods.description: Extracts an array of AnyCodable from an AnyCodable value.

methods.name: anyCodableEqual
methods.description: Checks for equality between two Optional AnyCodable values.
